notes: Verified against catalog. ABET-accredited. Electrical/systems-engineering emphasis. This major's catalog curriculum does NOT list BILD 1 or any lower-division biology course; it substitutes ECE circuits courses (ECE 35, ECE 45) and BENG 2. Uses BENG 186B (not 186A). Same GPA and C- letter-grade rules as all BE majors.

buckets.label: Lower-division engineering
buckets.note: ECE 35/45 are circuits and systems; BENG 2 is a biosystems intro course.

buckets.label: Upper-division bioengineering core
buckets.note: BENG 187A-D and 188A/188B are the senior design sequence. Uses BENG 186B only.

buckets.label: Technical electives
buckets.note: Two courses from the departmental approved list; must meet ABET standards and be pre-approved. BENG 196/199 may count; 197/198 do not. Explicit departmental pre-approved TE list for Bioengineering: BioSystems (BE29), from the official BE dept PDF (TE List - BSYS, last updated May 2023). Requirement = 8 units total, and unlike other BE majors ALL units must be 'engineering' primary component; so only Jacobs School of Engineering upper-division (100-series) courses qualify -- no Bio/Chem/Physics science courses count for BioSystems. Courses must be taken for a letter grade. BENG 196 (industrial internship) may count for 4 units toward one TE; BENG/CENG/ECE/MAE/NANO 199 count only as two quarters with the same faculty (satisfies both TEs / all 8 units). ENG 100D + two quarters of ENG 100L (TIES) together give 8 units. BENG 197 and BENG 198 do NOT count. List is subject to change; verify with BE Student Affairs before enrollment. Source: https://bioengineering.ucsd.edu/sites/default/files/uploads/TE%20List%20-%20BSYS%205.12.pdf
